stem: A logistics company wants to run inference physically inside its own warehouse facility for data-residency reasons, and separately wants to serve city-based mobile users from an AWS-operated metro location without deploying any private hardware. Which TWO services fit? (Select TWO.)

choices.text: AWS Compute Optimizer analyzing the workload's EC2 usage

rationale: AWS Outposts brings AWS-managed infrastructure into a customer's own facility, matching the warehouse's data-residency requirement. AWS Local Zones extend AWS compute into AWS-operated metro locations near end users, matching the city-based mobile users' need with no private hardware to deploy. AWS Wavelength embeds compute inside a telecom provider's 5G network specifically, which is neither the customer's own facility nor a general metro location. A partition placement group only controls proximity of instances to each other within one Availability Zone; it does not change which physical facility a workload runs in. Compute Optimizer analyzes utilization history to recommend rightsizing; it has nothing to do with where a workload physically runs.
